name: Neon Junction
bio: Neon Junction is a 3-piece live electronic act based in Delhi NCR.
artist_vibe_summary: Neon Junction delivers an uplifting, energetic fusion of electronic chillout production, ambient soundscapes, and organic instrumentation complemented by prominent live vocals. This polished sonic signature establishes them as a versatile live electronic act well-suited for contemporary festival and venue stages.
